notes: CDER CGMP letter for an OTC drug labeler/repackager/distributor (Dayton, NJ): inadequate quality-unit oversight of suppliers and contract manufacturers, improper warehouse segregation of unlabeled and labeled product, lack of lot traceability, and an unexplained active packaging/labeling line using rejected/expired bulk tablets and bottles. All product and label identities are redacted as (b)(4) and none is named in clear, so product_redacted is true. recall_concern is true given the explicit references to facilitating recall, quarantine procedures, and assessing the impact on drug products already distributed. No sterile/aseptic claims are made.
